source_status: Prepared for the initial supervised synthetic suite; unexecuted at this freeze, not accepted for scientific integration.
invocation_sequence: Construct CostContract from exact bound definition and schema bytes.
Construct optional fixed CostCheckpoint; no algorithm callbacks are accepted.
Construct CostLedger with a caller-owned existing spool parent; ingest detached raw rows and finalize identity, capture and rollup checks.
Compare an independently supplied capture inventory using raw_cost_row_id and canonical_record_sha256. The invoking layer authenticates its independent journal binding.
Construct AllocationContext from retained candidate, class and frozen-winner data.
Construct TimingIndex from retained cm_timing_block records.
Call reduce_cost_component with the complete supplied edge stream. Edge validation precedes reduction. A typed malformed-input error is not converted to partial success.
For a computable projection, retain AllocationReduction for compare_manifest_costs. Supply hard prerequisites from the trusted invoking layer, not from the candidate manifest.
Compare fixed dependency/public-key metadata, independently supplied admission/source metadata, and exact companion byte streams separately.
Persist outputs, typed failures, checkpoint state and cleanup failures in the invoking layer's custody record before closing and eventually cleaning owned indexes.

context.candidate_origins: Exactly I0,I1,I2 mapped to the actual nonnegative starting ordinal, or null when no origin has been observed. No inferred zero or inferred accepted-candidate ordinal.
context.candidate_prefix_rule: Contiguous per-interval prefixes begin at their explicitly supplied origin. Global-counter offsets are preserved. Joins use (interval,event_ordinal), not list indexing. No work follows second acceptance; unavailable is a terminal retained prefix entry.
context.retained_producer_interface_finding: TASK-20260908-35abb7/driver.py discover_frozen_panel increments one global counter before each attempt. Its fixture_wire omits accepted candidate_ordinal. The future runner must preserve every accepted and rejected ordinal and each observed interval origin; this component must not infer missing history.
context.class_memberships: Map from accepted fixture IDs to exactly C0 and C1, each containing two distinct K0..K3 labels; the two classes partition all four labels. Missing entire fixture partitions remain unresolved.
context.freeze_boundary: The component compares winners with retained selection scores. The invoking layer must establish that freezing preceded confirmation; label consistency does not establish this.

timing_record.repetitions: Actual integer 1..100, or null if unavailable. No inferred repetition count.
timing_record.cumulative_group_CPU_nanoseconds: Array of observed cumulative integer group CPU after each whole-q repetition, allowing explicit null unavailable observations; or null for unavailable prefix. Known counts require matching array length. No earlier observed prefix may meet the stop threshold before a later repetition.
timing_record.replay_verified: Explicit boolean or null; supplied observation, not replay performed by this component.
timing_record.resource_accounted: Explicit boolean or null; supplied observation, not authentication of resource receipts.
timing_record.controls: Source controls have endpoint null and their frozen named arm. They cannot acquire endpoint or class identity.
timing_record.estimator: Allocated repeated leaf CPU divided by actual retained repetition count. Observed group CPU controls stopping and resolution; it does not replace the allocated numerator.

cost_outputs.governing_loo: Seed606103/q4096 has exactly one joint omitted_block label0..6 each; all other cells have empty leave_one_out. Whole correctly labelled item permutations are accepted.
cost_outputs.invalid_original_block: All seven original blocks must be valid before any omission. Setup, actual selection expenditure, class labels and winners remain fixed.
cost_outputs.partial_route: Only a valid but unresolved allocation projection returns partial_projection with cost_projection null, actual physical accounting and retained issue access. Invalid input and infrastructure errors remain typed exceptions.
cost_outputs.conditional_branch: Exact 6/5 success and 1 negative thresholds across every governing full and LOO ratio, subject to separately supplied hard prerequisites and the fixed outcome relation. No automatic hypothesis promotion.

dependency_key_convention.unknowns: Version-only entries have null sha256 and an explicit reason; file/key-only entries have null version and an explicit reason. Equality with metadata is not an installed-runtime probe.
